writeup.key_factor: The model makes Carolina a 65.7% favorite (fair -192) at home — Hurricanes 1600 + 35 home-ice vs Capitals 1522 — but Pinnacle offers -147. Washington is without Pierre-Luc Dubois (illness) and defensemen Matt Roy and Rasmus Sandin, while Carolina has won five straight behind the league's best expected-goals share (60.6%) and Pyotr Kochetkov (3-0-0) was in the starter's crease at the morning skate.
writeup.risk: Captain Jordan Staal is out 1-2 months (calf tear) and Seth Jarvis is on IR, thinning Carolina's center depth. Logan Thompson is a strong goaltender who can steal a game, and Carolina's starter is not formally confirmed — if Brandon Bussi (.871 SV%) goes instead of Kochetkov, the edge shrinks. Re-check the goalie at the pregame check.
